column1: # A shell carries no game content and serves any game at run time, so every value here is either neutral or replaced at run time:
#   modules        -> read from the Guest library's __dm<name>x0 sections (host/loader.c dm_shell_modules, main.m)
#   romfs_marker   -> the shell accepts any existing non-empty romfs directory (main.m romfs_locate)
#   chain version  -> read from msl/b-<version> (gfx/nvn/nvn_mtl.m DM_CHAIN)
#   Shader tables, rewriter tables, shader libraries and the RomFS are written into the app by the packer, not here.
# The memory values below are a middle-of-the-road set; a game that needs different ones is served by Documents/env.txt.
